13_exit_beacon.note: Overlapped publication is the slim default: the VBlank interrupt publishes the tail while the next update casts, so updates finish sooner and this living-world capture lands on another accepted simulation tick (a door panel a step further open, an actor or beacon animation frame, the helmet blink, a drop a tick apart). Reviewed by eye; every frame check passes against the state the packet was handed off with.

14_level_complete.note: Wall and door textures overhauled into one coherent set (bolted steel panels, louvred vents, sliding doors with a hazard band, riveted reactor plates, coolant pipes, recessed hull panels, relay racks), and doors now darken along their own palette order instead of turning bright at distance: only wall and door pixels change; every frame check, including dynamic_tiles_exact against the reference read from VRAM, passes.
